lookbookCommentID.format: SHA-256(moderationPrincipalID + ':' + operation + ':' + clientRequestID) within the post comments path

globalBlockVisibility.participantListAndProfile: unchanged for both users; never reveal the block
globalBlockVisibility.directInteraction: the blocker must unblock first; notify the blocker only
globalBlockVisibility.chatCurrentWindow: messages admitted before block success remain until the room screen session ends
globalBlockVisibility.chatNewAdmission: filter by current blocked UID set without blockedAt comparison
globalBlockVisibility.ordering: hidden messages consume realtime seq and raw pagination cursor
globalBlockVisibility.localPayload: do not retroactively delete GRDB, FTS, attachments, or media cache
globalBlockVisibility.secondarySurfaces: filter search, gallery, reply, user announcement, room preview, banner, unread, and push
globalBlockVisibility.systemEvents: room lifecycle and moderation events remain visible
globalBlockVisibility.lookbook: hide the blocked author's current comments and replies immediately
globalBlockVisibility.unblock: do not force a room reload; future admission is visible and history returns through ordinary reload
globalBlockVisibility.bootstrap: load account snapshot into memory then replace from owner-only server relation; no snapshot plus server failure fails closed
globalBlockVisibility.rollout: latest app and server contract only

roomBanAccess.activeRoomRead: allow list, search, preview, message and public media read
roomBanAccess.membership: deny create or rejoin while the canonical moderation principal is banned
roomBanAccess.write: deny participant socket join and message or media writes
roomBanAccess.projectionEffects: remove member and joinedRooms; joined-only push, banner and share targets disappear
roomBanAccess.localAfterRemoval: keep message, FTS and completed media cache; cancel pending outbox and unfinished uploads; transition to read-only non-member
roomBanAccess.unban: allow a future explicit join without restoring membership
roomBanAccess.identityPrivacy: ban lists use the ban-time minimum display snapshot and never resolve a rejoined UID profile
roomBanAccess.selfAccessQuery: getMyRoomAccess returns member|joinable|banned|closed without moderationPrincipalID or ban document data

chatMediaDeliveryJobs/{roomID_messageID}.delivery: at-least-once; Socket and iOS deduplicate by messageID and seq

invariants.reasonCounts: counts all accepted submissions per reason

invariants.reviewRevision: increments only when a terminal review reopens because of a new submission

mediaProcessing.sequenceAllocation: same transaction as ready message creation

handledBy: room creator remove and rejoin ban

socketRateLimit.principalMissing: fail closed without UID or email fallback
socketRateLimit.newBucketAtCapacity: fail closed and emit content-free metric

commentReplyRateLimit.scope: comments and replies combined globally per moderationPrincipalID

commentReplyRateLimit.sameIDMatchingAuthorParentAndMessage: return existing commentID and current count projection
commentReplyRateLimit.clientRequestIDLifecycle: create UUID on submit; keep across network retries; replace after edit, cancel, success, or a new submission
commentReplyRateLimit.rateLimitedUX: preserve input, show a wait message, and allow user-initiated retry after retryAt

logging.historicalInternalQALogs: natural Cloud Logging retention; no retrospective deletion or new export

observed cross-process limiter inconsistency or abuse
redis.futureRole: Socket.IO adapter and PubSub plus shared rate limiter with separate keyspaces and TTLs

moderationScope.textChatLookbookCommentReply: no automatic meaning filter; report, block, room operation, and administrator post-review
moderationScope.chatImageAndVideo: Phase 7 quarantine, technical validation, metadata removal, and normalization before ready publication; no external meaning filter

mediaSafetyPolicy.dedicatedCloudRunRole: actual MIME/codec/dimensions/size/duration/track validation, metadata removal, and normalization
mediaSafetyPolicy.imageLimits: maximum 30 attachments per message; quarantine source 15 MiB each and 150 MiB aggregate; long edge 4096px
mediaSafetyPolicy.supportedImageSelections: JPEG, HEIC, PNG, animated GIF; iOS creates a transport source with orientation baked, 4096px long edge, sRGB, and unnecessary metadata removed; HEIC/HEIF and JPEG use JPEG quality 0.92; transparent and initially non-transparent PNG remain PNG; GIF animation is preserved
mediaSafetyPolicy.acceptedImageTransportFormats: JPEG, PNG, animated GIF; raw HEIC/HEIF is rejected as unsupportedMedia
mediaSafetyPolicy.videoLimits: one 720p H.264/AAC MP4 transport source per message; 350 MiB source and server-result limit; no duration limit
mediaSafetyPolicy.videoThumbnail: client local thumbnail is pending-UI only and is not uploaded; worker extracts a metadata-free 512px JPEG at min(1 second, duration/2); extraction failure is invalidMedia
mediaSafetyPolicy.cloudRunJobRuntime: 2 vCPU; 1024 MiB memory; one task; parallelism 1; attachments processed sequentially; platform retries 0
mediaSafetyPolicy.reportEvidenceCopy: selected stable attachment IDs only; deterministic dedupe; full normalized video once with reportedAtSeconds

mediaProcessingCapacityPolicy.globalExecutionAuthority: a dispatcher must acquire a fixed Firestore slot lease before starting a Cloud Run Job; Cloud Tasks concurrency alone is not authoritative

activeUploadsPerPrincipal.meaning: concurrent uploading, queued, or processing messages only; terminal releases the fixed principal slot; not a cumulative or daily transfer limit
activeUploadsPerPrincipal.idempotency: the same clientMutationID retry does not acquire another slot

iosLocalUploadQueue.scope: canonical principal, independent FIFO lane per media kind, shared by ChatContainer
iosLocalUploadQueue.localConcurrency: one active message per image lane and one per video lane from reservation through terminal
iosLocalUploadQueue.capacityResponse: chat:mediaPreflight active_upload_limit is waiting, not failure
iosLocalUploadQueue.identity: retry the same uploadID and clientMutationID while waiting for a slot
iosLocalUploadQueue.exitBehavior: app exit or room leave cancels waiting/active foreground tasks and never restarts file PUT automatically; relaunch stages the local bubble as silent pending before network status lookup, resumes monitoring when the server already committed queued/processing/ready, and polls an uploading session status-only after 2/4/8 seconds before cancel plus manual retry/delete
iosLocalUploadQueue.failurePresentation: ordinary image and video failures show retry/delete only in the failed bubble without a global popup; a room-ban interruption keeps the explicit participation-restriction alert
iosLocalUploadQueue.serverQueue: not created; no reservation document or signed URL exists while waiting locally

mediaProcessingCapacityPolicy.dailyByteLimit: not set initially; decide from observed usage and abuse metrics before increasing capacity

mediaReportVisibilityPolicy.reporterImmediateHide: selected attachments only; hide whole message when every image is selected or the message is video; persists after admin dismissal
mediaReportVisibilityPolicy.globalHideState: hiddenPendingReview on the same message ID and sequence
mediaReportVisibilityPolicy.urgentThreshold: 2 distinct canonical moderation principals within 24 hours in the same review revision
mediaReportVisibilityPolicy.generalThreshold: 3 distinct canonical moderation principals within 24 hours in the same review revision
mediaReportVisibilityPolicy.dismissalRestore: same message ID and sequence; no new push, banner, latestSeq, read-frontier rollback, or synthetic unread
mediaReportVisibilityPolicy.confirmedViolation: convert the existing sequence to a deleted tombstone
mediaReportVisibilityPolicy.deletedBeforeSubmission: evidence unavailable; accepted into target aggregate but excluded from global-hide thresholds and sole sanction evidence

storage.evidenceSource: copy the normalized display actually shown to users, never the raw quarantine source

chat:mediaRefreshUploadTargets.authorization: active uploading reservation owner without room ban

retention.moderationLedgerProductionTTLActivation: blocked until legal and privacy review approves purpose and duration
retention.mediaReservationOperationalCleanup: upload reservation expires after two hours and the processing deadline is six hours; ready, canceled, final failed, or expired immediately releases execution/principal leases and deletes quarantine source independently of moderation ledger retention
retention.mediaUploadTerminalDocument: expires seven days after ready, canceled, failed, or expired to preserve idempotent outbox replay
retention.quarantineObject: delete immediately after ready, canceled, final failed, or expired terminal cleanup; the one-day lifecycle is only a backstop for objects left by crashes, IAM/network errors, or cleanup bugs; soft delete is disabled
retention.readyTechnicalValidationMetadata: retained only for an approved bounded period; Production release is blocked until that period is set
retention.reportedMediaEvidence: open or inReview until decision; dismissal, content-delete-only, or warning-only enqueues immediate asynchronous deletion; account sanction evidence is retained for a 30-day appeal window and, if appealed in time, until appeal resolution
retention.reportedMediaEvidenceAccess: not exposed to clients; an active platform administrator may retrieve only a specific evidence object through server authentication and audited authorization; delivery method is revisited by admin-web-operations-migration
retention.roomClosureTombstone: room content is removed immediately; shared tombstone and unacknowledged memberships remain at most 14 days, then the cleanup scheduler removes them in bounded batches
retention.legacyRoomClosureNotice: no longer created; existing notices keep their Production 30-day TTL and are deleted by the new acknowledgment callable when confirmed
retention.completedCleanupJob: expires seven days after completion; failed jobs do not expire automatically
retention.reportRateLimitBucket: operational metadata only, expiresAt two days after the bucket; contains no report detail or evidence
retention.commentWriteRateLimitBucket: operational metadata only, expiresAt two days after the bucket; contains no comment, reply, target detail, or provider identity
